forces.title: Policy to establish medical tourism hubs enhances social infrastructure
forces.description: The Union Budget 2026–27 introduces a scheme to support states in establishing five Regional Medical Hubs. This government-backed initiative aims to enhance India's position as a global destination for medical and wellness tourism. These hubs represent significant investments in healthcare infrastructure, which, although not explicitly stated as PPP, are highly likely to involve public-private partnerships given the scale and funding mechanisms for social infrastructure projects. This directly contributes to the expansion of hospital assets within the social infrastructure node.
forces.source_title: Tourism And Hospitality Industry In India

viewpoints.title: Government scheme boosts medical tourism infrastructure in states
viewpoints.description: IBEF highlights the Union Budget 2026–27's scheme to support states in establishing five Regional Medical Hubs. This initiative is geared towards positioning India as a global destination for medical and wellness tourism. While the explicit use of a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model is not detailed, such state-backed infrastructure development frequently involves PPPs to finance and operate large-scale facilities like hospitals, directly contributing to the growth of social infrastructure assets.
viewpoints.source_title: Tourism And Hospitality Industry In India

demand_drivers.description: India is recognized for building a holistic medical tourism ecosystem offering affordable and high-quality care, leading to strong demand and projected growth to USD 16 billion by 2030.
